tools.name: find_borrowing_products
tools.description: Use when a user asks which loan, credit, card, mortgage, or other borrowing products may fit stated requirements in a supported country. Returns governed match states, not eligibility or approval.

tools.name: compare_borrowing_costs
tools.description: Use after product discovery to compare evidence-backed, scenario-bound borrowing costs for two or more returned products. Does not mix incompatible products or representative scenarios.

tools.name: check_product_requirements
tools.description: Use when a user wants documented requirements checked for one returned product using supplied non-sensitive characteristics. Never predicts eligibility or approval.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Use when a user asks for evidence-backed facts, limitations, requirements, applicability, or commercial handoff details for one canonical product.
